metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Meesaya Murukku 2
metas.description: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Orange
metas.description: High school student Naho Takamiya receives a letter from her future self that warns her to avoid mistakes she will make involving a new transfer student, Kakeru Naruse, a troubled boy whom she meets and begins to fall in love with.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2012 · Thattathin Marayathu
metas.description: The struggles faced when a Hindu man falls in love with a Muslim woman and the disapproval of her family.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Chiram
metas.description: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 1988 · Cocktail
metas.description: A talented New York City bartender takes a job at a bar in Jamaica and falls in love.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Maruva Tarama
metas.description: At a Goa restaurant, Anvi meets a naval officer for arranged marriage talks. Though beautiful and from a wealthy family, she hides a secret - her heart belongs to another. She declines his proposal.
